title: Cardi B Attends KATSEYE’s New York Concert With Daughters
summary: Cardi B brought daughters Kulture and Blossom to the concert after previously declaring her love for the group and “Hootie Frutti.”
contentText:
Cardi B brought daughters Kulture and Blossom to KATSEYE’s New York concert on Saturday night (Oct. 24), continuing a run of very public support for the six-member girl group.

The rapper was spotted dancing with two-year-old Blossom from what appeared to be a VIP suite during the show, while Cardi later shared footage to her Instagram Story showing her daughters and their friends after the concert.

Cardi’s KATSEYE fandom has been building for months. Earlier this year, she went viral after footage showed her enthusiastically lip-syncing to “Gabriela” during the group’s Governors Ball performance in New York, prompting fans to jokingly dub her KATSEYE’s unofficial seventh member.

She doubled down on that support in August when “Hootie Frutti” drew criticism online following its release.

“Y’all hating on the song,” Cardi said during an Instagram Live at the time. “But me, Kulture, and Amor, we love this song. And Blossom love it.”

The latest concert outing comes during a major year for KATSEYE.

Released Aug. 14 via HYBE x Geffen Records, WILD followed the group’s 2025 EP BEAUTIFUL CHAOS , which debuted at No. 4 on the Billboard 200. The project also included “Gabriela,” which became one of KATSEYE’s six entries on the Billboard Hot 100 and peaked at No. 21 on the chart earlier this year.

The group continued its chart rise with WILD , which produced additional Hot 100 hits including “PINKY UP” and “Animal.” “Animal” debuted at No. 24 on the Hot 100 and also gave KATSEYE their first top 10 on the Billboard Global 200, where it debuted at No. 10.

KATSEYE launched their Wildworld Tour in Dublin on Sept. 1, with the arena run taking the group through Europe and North America.

The overlap has extended beyond music, too. Gap Inc. is set to receive the CFDA’s Innovation Award in November, with the company highlighting both KATSEYE’s Better in Denim campaign and Old Navy’s fall denim campaign starring Cardi B among its recent fashion projects.
